tagline: A premier net lease real estate investment trust focused on acquiring and managing high-quality commercial properties across diversified tenant base.
hero_kpi_rationale: Capex in real estate acquisitions is the primary growth driver for BNL, directly reflecting the expansion of its lease portfolio and its risk-adjusted return strategy.

kpis.name: Real Estate Acquisition Investments
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in new real estate acquisitions and revenue-generating improvements.
kpis.description: In 2025, BNL invested $438.2 million in new acquisitions and improvements, compared to $237.3 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Very strong capex growth in 2025, signaling active expansion.

kpis.name: Net Lease Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated from lease agreements after adjustments.
kpis.description: Net lease revenue increased by 5.2% in 2025, driven by rent increases and portfolio expansion.
kpis.signal: Stable lease revenue growth, the main growth engine.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income declined by 41.2% in 2025, primarily due to lower gains on real estate dispositions.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline in net income due to reduced capital gains on sales.

kpis.name: Interest Expense
kpis.explanation: Annual cost of debt incurred by the company.
kpis.description: Interest expense increased by 27.5% in 2025, due to new borrowings and the termination of interest rate swaps.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in interest expense linked to higher leverage.

kpis.name: Gain on Sale
kpis.explanation: Profit realized from the sale of real estate assets.
kpis.description: Gain on sale decreased from $73.2 million in 2024 to $12.6 million in 2025.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline in gains on sale, a major impact on net income.

kpis.name: Impairment Charge
kpis.explanation: Amount reserved for the loss in value of real estate assets.
kpis.description: Impairment charge was $39.7 million in 2025 versus $49.0 million in 2024, related to changes in holding strategy.
kpis.signal: Slight improvement compared to 2024, but remains high.

kpis.name: Net Leverage Ratio
kpis.explanation: Measure of debt relative to operating cash flow (Adjusted EBITDAre).
kpis.description: The Net Debt / Adjusted EBITDAre ratio was 6.0x at the end of 2025, in line with strategic targets.
kpis.signal: Maintenance of a target leverage ratio, consistent with investment grade rating.

kpis.name: Real Estate Acquisition Investments
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in new real estate acquisitions and revenue-generating improvements.
kpis.description: Capex significantly increased in 2025, reflecting an active expansion strategy.

kpis.name: Net Lease Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated from lease agreements after adjustments.
kpis.description: Lease revenue increased by 5.2% in 2025, driven by new assets.
kpis.signal: Steady growth supported by portfolio expansion.

risks.title: Tenant Default
risks.score_rationale: A tenant default could result in a significant loss of revenue and asset value for the company. The company has long-term leases with tenants, which increases default risk.

risks.title: Geographic Concentration
risks.score_rationale: The company's concentration in certain states may make it vulnerable to adverse economic and regulatory developments in those regions.

risks.title: Property Concentration
risks.score_rationale: The company's concentration in certain property types may expose it to adverse developments in those sectors.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate fluctuations may affect the company's ability to finance acquisitions and refinance its debt.

risks.title: Acquisition Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company's growth depends on its ability to acquire new properties, which may be affected by market conditions and competition.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant debt ($2.5B as of December 2025), which may increase its exposure to credit risk in case of payment default.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to government regulations, which may affect its operations and financial results.

ai_positioning.summary: BNL does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its report. The information provided primarily concerns financial statements, real estate assets, and leasing operations.
